newsitem.title: CHINA: Sichuan Changhong 1996 net up 45 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sichuan Changhong 1996 net up 45 pct.

text.p: China's most profitable listed firm, Sichuan Changhong Electric Co Ltd, said on Wednesday its 1996 net profits were 1.675 billion yuan, a leap of 45.5 percent on 1995's 1.151 billion yuan.
Turnover in 1996 for Changhong, China's biggest television maker, was 10.588 billion yuan, up 56.5 percent from 6.764 billion yuan in 1995, the company's annual report said.

The company sold 4.77 million colour television sets in 1996, expanding its share of the domestic Chinese market to 27 percent, from 1995's 22 percent, mainly due to price cuts early in 1996, the report said.
Changhong's performance has been the best of China's 500 listed firms since its listing on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 1994, the official China Securities News said on Wednesday.
Changhong was the only listed firm in China to post earnings per share of more than two yuan for the past four years, the newspaper said.
